- I6: launch line '2026-11-07T15:03:17-03:00 launch kagi round=60' confirmed (watchdog :3217; '15:09:28' absent); range a677c78e..818d2a82 holds 9 committer times.

DEFECT TO REPORT (frozen predicate not amended): I6's 'at least three -03:00 timestamps that each occur in git log --format=%ci a677c78e..818d2a82' is literally unsatisfiable — %ci emits '2026-11-07 16:33:44 -0300' (space separator, offset -0300); measured literal '-03:00' matches in that output = 0. The -03:00/T form is %cI. A literal checker finds nothing and I6 can never hold, which K2 forbids. Fix belongs in the checker's comparison (compare instants, normalising the offset) and in the section C1 wording (%cI or an explicit normalisation rule); 9 candidate instants exist, so 'at least three' is satisfiable once normalised.

AMBIGUITIES (bytes-only checker must be told): A2 — I2's '--selftest in the selftest cell' conjunct is ALREADY true at BASE (row 855 contains --selftest twice); only removal of 'none of its own' discriminates, so the condition should require the cell to name the counter's own invocation.
